title: Doubly Robust Distributionally Robust Offline Contextual Pricing
abstract: arXiv:2610.30957v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Offline contextual pricing often relies on logged observational data, but faces challenges from distributional shifts between training and deployment environments. Distributionally robust optimization (DRO) provides a principled approach to off-policy evaluation and learning (OPE/L). However, existing methods are mostly limited to discrete actions. Recent work has explored DRO for continuous treatments using inverse propensity weighting (IPW), while such IPW-based estimators can be sensitive to the convergence rate of propensity score estimates, particularly when estimated nonparametrically, which may lead to larger estimation errors and regret. In this work, we develop a doubly robust (DR) framework for distributionally robust OPE/L in continuous pricing settings. translated_title: 双重稳健的分布式鲁棒离线上下文定价
translated_abstract: 离线上下文定价通常依赖于记录的观测数据，但面临训练环境与部署环境之间分布偏移的挑战。分布式鲁棒优化为离线策略评估与学习（OPE/L）提供了一种有原则的方法。然而，现有方法大多仅限于离散动作。最近的工作探索了使用逆倾向加权（IPW）对连续处理进行分布式鲁棒优化，但此类基于IPW的估计器对倾向得分估计的收敛速度较为敏感，特别是在非参数估计的情况下，这可能导致更大的估计误差和遗憾。在这项工作中，我们为连续定价环境下的分布式鲁棒OPE/L开发了一个双重稳健（DR）框架。对于评估，我们提出了一个局部化DR估计器，通过仅拟合少量回归来解决最坏情况期望的计算挑战……
tldr: 本文针对连续定价场景下的分布式鲁棒离线策略评估与学习，提出了一个双重稳健框架，通过局部化DR估计器克服了基于IPW方法对倾向得分估计收敛速度的敏感性以及最坏情况期望的计算难题。
